name: Adobe Express
tagline: Adobe's all-in-one design, photo and video app for quick content, with Firefly generative AI built in.
about: Adobe Express is a simple design tool for social posts, flyers and short videos. It includes templates and Firefly AI for generating images and text effects.
pros: Templates for social posts, flyers and videos.
Firefly generative AI is built in.
cons: Less powerful than Photoshop or Illustrator for detailed work.
